title: Bond Energy Calculations

problems_fixed.what: Stored answer was wrong. CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O with the given bond energies (C-H=412, O=O=498, C=O=743, O-H=463): broken = 4x412 + 2x498 = 2644; made = 2x743 + 4x463 = 3338; dH = 2644 - 3338 = -694. The problem's own misconception text already computed -694, confirming -810 was a typo.

misconceptions_repaired: Every misconception was missing the required `expect` key (validator + honest-diagnosis need it). Added a determinate `expect` to all 12 problems, each derived by committing the specific error (wrong_sign reversed subtraction, forgot_coefficient / wrong_count under-counting bonds, wrong_rearrange add-instead-of-subtract, added-product-bond). Every expect sits outside the answer. Recomputed all after the G1 fix.
hints_added: Gold problems (G0, G1, G2) had neither hint nor equation_hint (validator fail); added plain-text hints. Added a `hint` to every bank problem for the wrong-answer lifeline while keeping all existing `equation_hint` recall toggles byte-for-byte.
em_dash_fixes: exam_context.frequency: 'Medium — bond energy...' -> 'Common: bond energy questions appear regularly' (em dash rejected by validator).
worked_examples step labels: 'Step 1 — Bonds broken' etc. -> 'Step 1: Bonds broken' (pre-existing em dashes, student-facing Learn view).
opener_concept: Demolition-and-rebuild budget: knocking a shed down COSTS money (energy in, bonds broken); selling salvaged materials while rebuilding PAYS money back (energy out, bonds made). Two boxes (profit 864-679=185; loss 720-500=220) let a student who has never met enthalpy answer by common sense, then the reveal names dH = energy in - energy out and maps the two signs to exothermic/endothermic.

teach_walks.bronze: H2 + Br2 -> 2HBr, full simple calc, dH = -103 (exothermic).
teach_walks.silver: N2 + O2 -> 2NO, teaches the coefficient-2 move on the product, dH = +183 (endothermic, shows a positive dH).
teach_walks.gold: 2CO + O2 -> 2CO2, coefficients on both sides and 4 C=O bonds counted, dH = -568 (exothermic).

board_neutral: No board named; method_card says 'check whether your board gives you the bond energies'. Bond energies are always supplied in the question, so no equation-sheet claim made. Serves AQA + Edexcel + OCR (science-ocr-b + separate-sciences-ocr-b) rows.
tier_ladder_note: Existing bank is a chained scaffold, not a strict units ladder: Bronze isolates single sub-steps (break, make, combine, sign) of H2+Cl2; Silver adds coefficient counting on 2H2+O2; Gold is the full multi-step calculation (NH3, methane combustion, rearrange). This matches the science ladder (Gold = multi-step) so no reordering done.

Confirmed both all_row_ids byte-identical to the shard and live canonical passes the validator.
